name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate aligned to the ACE-1.5 reward model — keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0 (keeps neutral/uncredited patterns, drops only genuinely-bad), in both the main and domain-shift gates. Domain-shift injection bounded server-side via --top-k 8 (per-tool-call hot path; the server selects the best <=8) while the main + subagent searches stay uncapped (server search_top_k). Bullet summary shows the bandit ranking (up-arrow ucb_score) instead of a misleading reward 0.0 on uncredited projects. Statusline: rate-limit percentages rounded + resets_at epochs formatted to local time + printf hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2 (the SDK isAtRisk fix: at-risk now means reward<0). v7.1.1: Domain-shift injection hardening — PreToolUse + PostToolUse domain-shift searches now reuse the task's task_session_id via --pin-session (no more retrieval_log_v15.session_id=NULL) and apply the same USEFUL_FIELDS strip + v15 quality gate as the main search, so domain-shift no longer leaks raw server-internal pattern payloads (~46KB → stripped/gated) or isAtRisk patterns. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, Claude Code >= 2.1.163, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution — SubagentStart fires a per-subagent start-search (query from transcript, keyed to the subagent's agent_id) so every subagent/workflow-agent gets patterns + creditable learns; plus a per-TASK session_id (fresh uuid per task, shared by search+learn) replacing the CC conversation session_id so the server correlates search↔learn per task. No floor bump. v7.0.2: Fix outdated /ace:ace-doctor — hook map now matches hooks.json (10 events incl. PreToolUse, PermissionRequest/Denied, SessionEnd, SubagentStop + PostToolUse domain-inject), @ace-sdk/cli package, dynamic $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT path, ace-cli 4.x device-code auth model, v1.x-config migration detection. New self-sync test suite (25 assertions). v7.0.0: ACE 1.5 / ace-cli 4.0.1 compatibility milestone. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
